description: This file contains the seeding logic for initializing the identity database with default roles and users in an ASP.NET Core application, specifically creating roles and default users for authentication purposes.

classes.name: AppIdentityDbContextSeed
classes.description: A static class responsible for seeding initial data into the Identity database, including roles and default users.

methods.name: SeedAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously seeds the identity database with default roles and users, including an administrator and a demo user.
